_doc: ONE OWNING MODULE per guarded table (drift exit bar, Athi 28 Nov 2026). tests/one-reader-tables.test.cjs fails the build when SQL on the table appears outside the owner, except the dated waivers below (a waiver is a file + how many lines + why + date; the count may only go down, a new file or a higher count fails). state_patterns: a raw state predicate on the table outside the owner (the decision itself) fails with no waiver possible.
decision: stateOf (revoked | expired | edge_off | live) over stateColumnsSql; the SQL twin liveGrantSql; ended = endedSql

waivers.why: withdrawEnded: the INSERT..SELECT joins the grant row; the 'ended' test and its reason words are endedSql / endedReasonSql
liveGrantOf: selects the pair's rows with stateColumnsSql and hands them to grants.liveAmong (the verdict)
grantsRead: the firm's rows with stateColumnsSql, judged by grants.liveAmong in chooseLive
the audit trail names the firm and people of any party that holds or HELD a grant (revoked still names past actions): not a state decision
resolveFilter uses liveGrantSql and joins job chits; eligibilityOf selects rows with stateColumnsSql for verdictOf
reads the live grant's preset through liveGrantSql

db_backstop.what: security_invoker view books_access_grant_state (time half of the state on the database clock, SELECT only, caller RLS kept); base table keeps FORCE RLS + grant_read/insert/update policies
db_backstop.proof: sit-ae2 28 Nov 2026: owner path 3 rows (expired/open/revoked), stranger shop 0 rows via the view and 0 raw, UPDATE through the view refused
